name: Eder
title: Levite in David's Time
summary: Eder was a Levite from the clan of Merari who served in the temple service under King David. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the Levitical families organized for service in the sanctuary. The name Eder also appears in other contexts in the Bible, including as a city in Judah and as a descendant of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among Merari's Descendants
keyEvents.description: Eder is listed as the son of Mushi, grandson of Merari, in the genealogy of the Levites during King David's organization of temple service.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Levites Under David
keyEvents.description: King David organized the Levites into divisions for service in the house of the Lord, and Eder was among those assigned tasks.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogical Record
keyEvents.description: Eder is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles chapter 24 as part of Merari's descendants during the allocation of service divisions.

keyEvents.title: Mushi's Sons Without Daughters to Marry
keyEvents.description: It is noted that your brother Mahli had sons, but another lineage had only daughters who married their brothers' sons—a key point regarding inheritance rights among the Levites.
